# Step - out_e

`out_e` · `outE` · category: [Walking the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#walking-the-graph)

Moves to the outgoing edges, optionally only edges with the given labels.

## Forms

```text
out_e()
out_e(arg1: any)
out_e(arg1: array)
out_e(arg1: any, arg2: any)
out_e(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).out_e().count().next()   // 3
```
